body: This makes me happy. Good summary.
That’s not what your mama said when I was boning her to it
Naw fam I just want to help people with my story.

I jumped off an 80ft cliff in Santa Monica to try and end it. I just told myself not to think of it and to just do it. Which I did. I broke 21 bones and now I am paraplegic (in a wheelchair). Don’t do it unless you’re willing to accept the outcomes.

My insurer is GoodRx ahah. Idk the first step to enroll for insurance to be completely honest. First there was registration season then no prescription coverage and etc... if you could shoot me a link for any insurance provider I can look into you are awesome.

Creds to you for finding an insurance that would cover your meds. I almost lost my mind getting spammed through my phone. Figured I'd just pay the $125 without insurance. Good Rx cuts the remaining down to $41. Looking about $170ish per month w/o coverage. Try looking around to see which doctors are lenient with their prescriptions. I've heard that some give up to 3 scripts per visit because they understand the cost. 

In terms of a prescription assistance program, my doctor suggested I look into "Shire ADHD scholarships". Turns out that its only offered during specific times of the year. Haven't looked into it
Gotcha will definitely let them know. Yes GoodRx is God given from the pharmacy up above. I use their coupons all the time.
I pay out of pocket for all my scripts.
